A page that declares nothing and is awkward to read. Every construct here has defeated a hand-written tokenizer somewhere: a regular expression holding a slash, a division that looks like one, a template with a substitution inside a substitution, an apostrophe in prose, and a comment that talks about capabilities. If the parser loses its place in any of them it will misread what follows, and the only honest way to find that out is to make it read them.

It doesn't declare a capability. It doesn't mention window.claude except here, in prose, where nothing follows it.
